Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련을 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 한번 더 해보면 잘해낼 수 있다고 한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> claims she could do it better if she tries again. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニングに失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、もう一度やればうまくやれると言う。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说再来一次就能做好。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說再來一次就能做好。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a échoué à l'entraînement et dit qu'elle pourrait faire mieux si elle réessayait. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat das Training nicht bestanden, behauptet aber, sie könnte es besser machen, wenn sie es noch einmal versucht. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras fallar el entrenamiento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> afirma que podría hacerlo mejor si lo intenta de nuevo. ¿Qué debería decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que falhou no treino diz que pode fazer melhor se tentar de novo. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ฝึกไม่สำเร็จ บอกว่าถ้าลองอีกครั้งจะต้องทำได้ดีกว่าเดิม จะให้พูดว่าอะไรดีคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang gagal dalam latihan, mengatakan dia bisa berhasil jika mencoba lagi. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã thất bại trong buổi huấn luyện, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng nếu thử lại thì sẽ làm tốt hơn. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का कहना है कि अगर वह एक बार और कोशिश करे तो बेहतर कर सकती है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 아니, 오늘은 이만 쉬는 게 좋겠어.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: No, I think we should take a break today.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: いや、今日はもう休もう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 不，今天还是休息比较好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 不，今天還是休息比較好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Non, je pense qu'il est préférable de faire une pause aujourd'hui.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nein, ich denke, wir sollten heute eine Pause machen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No, creo que hoy deberíamos tomarnos un descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não, acho que é melhor fazermos uma pausa hoje.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่ค่ะ วันนี้พักผ่อนดีกว่า
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak, kurasa sebaiknya kita istirahat saja hari ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không, hôm nay nghỉ ngơi thì tốt hơn.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: नहीं, मुझे लगता है कि आज हमें आराम करना चाहिए।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right. Let's give it another try.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: In Ordnung. Geben wir uns mehr Mühe.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tudo bem. Vamos nos esforçar mais.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ได้เลยค่ะ มาพยายามอีกครั้งกันเถอะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được thôi. Cố gắng thêm lần nữa nhé.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है। चलो एक और कोशिश करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นโพชั่นพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một bình Thuốc Hồi Sức.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk mengakhiri latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã kết thúc buổi huấn luyện và quyết định nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak masih belum puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: आराम करने का फैसला करने के बावजूद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retenté l'entraînement et a obtenu de bons résultats.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> stellte sich der Herausforderung des Trainings erneut und erzielte gute Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba latihan lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử thách lại buổi huấn luyện và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम प्राप्त किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retenté l'entraînement, mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> stellte sich der Herausforderung des Trainings erneut, scheiterte aber.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งแต่ก็ยังล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba latihan lagi, tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử thách lại buổi huấn luyện nhưng lại thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
